description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy Revenue Protection Order No. 02 / 2025 Under Section 10 of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235)
categorisation: This gazette content contains a notification under the Customs Ordinance establishing new import duty rates for specific vehicle categories. It involves legal/regulatory matters by creating subsidiary legislation under an existing ordinance, specifically setting customs duty rates and regulatory requirements for imported vehicles. The content focuses on regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
